topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I stood there, gazing at the stump where my tree once stood, a silent sentinel of my youth. It was a sapling when I first planted it, a small gesture to honor my tenth birthday. Over the years, it grew with me, its branches reaching wide and strong, a testament to the care and time I invested. Now, though it's gone, what lingers is the strength of that bond, the assurance that something I touched has left its mark. The stump is just wood now, but it carries the story of a little girl who believed in the power of a single seed. I carry that with me, a quiet confidence that echoes through the years, deep and unshaken.
